# Abdul Aziz

> I enjoy taking messy problems and turning them into clean, working systems.

Abdul Aziz builds internal systems, AI agents and Shopify tools at Invizi in Sydney.

- **Site:** https://www.abdulaziz.au/
- **Email:** hello@abdulaziz.au
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/abdulazizsapra/

## Selected work

- **Stock and purchase planning** — internal supply planning system replacing Excel workbooks. Drafts container-filling purchase orders and follows them through to receipt.
- **Invoicing and order risk** — Shopify app for NDIS, Support at Home and business orders, with expiry reminders and an order-risk check.
- **Agents on live data** — AI agents answering operational questions in Slack, plus the pipelines behind them.

## Selected outcomes

- $4M in AU revenue invoiced annually.
- $1.4M in EU revenue supported annually by checkout messaging.
- 25% of AU revenue automated.

Annual figures from invoicing and checkout automation.

## Notes

- Subtract first. Most interfaces get better when you remove something.
- Boring is a feature. A system that still works in five years beats one that impresses in a demo.
- Automate the repeat. Once is a task; twice is a process.
